title: Zoe Rae's Cheshire Home: Luxury Media Wall, Home Gym, and Expensive Water Feature
text:
Zoe Rae, a fitness influencer, shared a glimpse inside her incredible Cheshire home on Instagram, complete with a luxury media wall, home gym, walk-in wardrobe, and an expensive water feature. She and her husband purchased the property earlier this year after living at her sister's mansion for nine months.
Zoe Rae shared a glimpse inside her incredible Cheshire home on Instagram which is complete with a luxury media wall, home gym, walk-in wardrobe, and an expensive water feature.
The influencer, 30, purchased her home with husband Danny Rae earlier this year after living at her sister Molly-Mae Hague's huge £4million Cheshire mansion for nine months. The couple have been busy furnishing the property and have made sure their garden is perfect for hosting as they added a large round dining table, a shaded sofa seating area, a barbeque, and hot tub.
However, it was the expensive lit-up water feature that caught the eye which is placed in the centre of the garden wall. The pair have renovated their garage into a state-of-the-art gym complete with a treadmill, rowing machine, SkiErg, squat rack, and several weights. Inside the home, Zoe showed off her lavish white open plan kitchen with a marble island as she cooked dinner.
